message.content: Starting triage on the reported energy violation — shrinking it to the minimal case.
Shrink isolated a single-body failure at step 3. Now verifying it replays and capturing states.
Replay confirms the violation. Now inspecting states around it to diagnose the cause.
Step 3 is high energy after a bounce. Checking earlier steps to trace the growth.
The upward launch should preserve speed at the ceiling bounce but it sped up — inspecting the intervening steps.
I see a fast upward launch into the ceiling with substepping active; checking the remaining step to complete the picture.
I see anomalous free-fall energy gain far beyond gravity. Testing a zero-gravity counterfactual to confirm the cause.
